title: 第25章 雷天行第26章 冤家路窄
slug: 被贬废丹房我偷偷无敌了

很快，陈长生就摸到了打斗的附近。
不过他没有立即现身，把枯木敛气诀和夜融术施展到极致，变成一道黑影暗暗靠近了打斗圈。
眼前的景象把陈长生吓了一跳，这里到处都是鬼气森森，阴风阵阵，鬼哭狼嚎之声。
不知道的还以为到了地狱之中。
除了中间的那道璀璨光华格外的夺目刺眼之外，那些黑衣人的法宝要么发出幽幽的火焰，要么黑气乱窜。
鬼影重重，很是吓人。
“这些到底是人是鬼？”陈长生躲在一块大石头后面屏气凝神，那些骷髅面具人除了为首的是筑基期外，其他的也都是炼气八九层的，有两三个无限接近筑基期了。
而且这些人摆的大阵也非常玄妙，黑气运转间构建起一个若有若无的黑气罩，每次夏雨蝶的攻击落到上面就如泥牛入海。
陈长生眉头一皱，现在这种情况自己上去也不见得能够破掉大阵，搞不好还会把自己给搭进去。
陈长生暗暗观察了会没有轻举妄动，他才不会傻傻的去英雄救美呢，美女虽香，但没有自己的小命重要。
“咦？这货怎么在这？”
就在这时，陈长生忽然发现在不远处有三道人影，中间的那人居然是李怀安那厮，在他身边还站着两名骷髅黑衣男子。
“这……难道李怀安和那些骷髅面具人是一伙的？”脑海中瞬间转过千般念头，陈长生暗暗吃了一惊。
只不过他实在不明白，那两名骷髅面具人明明修为比李怀安高，但却为何隐隐以他马首是瞻。
只听一名骷髅黑衣人道：“上使，没想到这个女人还挺能坚持的。”
另一人道：“这个小妞长得倒是不错，这么杀了太可惜了吧！”
李怀安淡淡道：“女人只不过都是红粉骷髅，你们要看清楚她们的本质之后自然就没多少兴趣了。”
两人微微躬身，“上使高见。”
李怀安点头，“嗯，你们两个也去帮忙吧，早点杀了那个女人，这里毕竟是望仙宗的地盘，此地不宜久留。”

“是，上使！”那两名骷髅男子说完身体一晃顿时加入了战圈。
“又是两名筑基期修士！”陈长生面色微微一变，这下夏雨蝶真是凶多吉少了，这可不能怪自己不帮忙了，真的帮不动啊！
陈长生打算就此跑路了。
就在这时，一道遁光由远及近声音老早传了过来，“夏师妹，我来助你！”
只是一个眨眼的功夫那遁光就迅速靠近，一名少年脚踏宽大飞剑，火红色的光罩把此地照的如同白昼。
李怀安面色一变，“不好！怎么是雷天行这个衰星，这下麻烦了。”
那叫雷天行的少年一飞过来，手中便出现一个人头大小的紫色雷球，狠狠朝战圈砸了过去。
轰的一声巨响，摧枯拉朽，那些黑色光罩顿时四分五裂，几名没有筑基的骷髅人身体倒飞出去口喷鲜血。
雷天行飞到夏雨蝶身边一脸关切的道：“师妹，你没事吧，我一接到你的传音立即就赶了过来。”
夏雨蝶见是雷天行顿时松了口气，有些娇嗔的道：“师兄，得亏你来得早，要不然我就要被鬼门宗的人给打杀了。”

Soon, Chen Changsheng touched the vicinity of the fight.
However, he did not show up immediately. He used the Dead Wood Qi Condensing Technique and the Night Melting Technique to the extreme, turning into a black shadow and approaching the fighting circle quietly.
The sight in front of him shocked Chen Changsheng. The place was filled with ghostly auras, gusty winds, and the sound of ghosts crying and wolves howling.
Those who didn’t know thought they were in hell.
In addition to the bright ray of light in the middle that is particularly dazzling, the magic weapons of the men in black either emit faint flames, or black energy is flowing around.
There were many ghosts and shadows, which was very scary.
"Are these humans or ghosts?" Chen Changsheng hid behind a big stone and held his breath. Except for the leader of the skull-masked men who were in the foundation-building stage, the others were all at the eighth or ninth level of Qi refining, and two or three of them were extremely close to the foundation-building stage.
Moreover, the formations set up by these people are also very mysterious. The black air circulates to build a vague black air cover. Every time Xia Yudie's attack falls on it, it is like a mud cow falling into the sea.
Chen Changsheng frowned. In this situation, he might not be able to break the formation by himself, and he might even get caught in it.
Chen Changsheng secretly observed whether Hui acted rashly. He would not foolishly act like a hero to save the beauty. Although the beauty is fragrant, it is not as important as his own life.
"Eh? Why is this guy here?"
At this moment, Chen Changsheng suddenly noticed three figures not far away. The man in the middle was actually Li Huaian. Next to him stood two skeleton men in black clothes.
"This...could it be that Li Huaian and those skull-masked people are in the same group?" Chen Changsheng was secretly surprised as thousands of thoughts flashed through his mind.
It's just that he really doesn't understand why the two skeleton masked men are obviously higher in cultivation than Li Huaian, but they vaguely follow him.
A skeleton in black clothes was heard saying: "Envoy, I didn't expect this woman to be able to persevere."
Another person said: "This girl is pretty good-looking. It would be a pity to kill her like this!"
Li Huaian said calmly: "Women are just red and pink skeletons. Once you see their true nature clearly, you will naturally not be interested in them."
The two of them bowed slightly and said, "Your Majesty, please give me your best advice."
Li Huaian nodded, "Well, you two should go help and kill that woman as soon as possible. After all, this is the territory of Wangxian Sect. It is not suitable to stay here for a long time."
"Yes, your Majesty!" After saying that, the two skeleton men swayed and immediately joined the battle circle.
"It's two more foundation-building monks!" Chen Changsheng's expression changed slightly. Now Xia Yudie is really in danger. You can't blame yourself for not helping, she really can't help!
Chen Changsheng planned to run away.
At this moment, a ray of light came from far away and a voice came from near, "Junior Sister Xia, let me help you!"
In just a blink of an eye, the escaping light quickly approached. A young man stepped on a large flying sword, and the fiery red light shield illuminated the place like daylight.
Li Huaian's expression changed, "No! It's Lei Tianxing, a bad star, who is in trouble now."
As soon as the young man named Lei Tianxing flew over, a purple thunder ball the size of a human head appeared in his hand, and he smashed it towards the battle circle.
With a loud bang, the black light shields suddenly fell into pieces, and the bodies of several skeletons without foundations flew out and spurted blood.
Lei Tianxing flew to Xia Yudie's side and said with concern: "Junior sister, are you okay? I rushed over as soon as I received your message."
When Xia Yudie saw that it was Lei Tianxing, she immediately breathed a sigh of relief and said a bit coquettishly: "Brother, thank you for coming early, otherwise I would have been killed by the people from the Ghost Sect."
